title: PMI: The $1,400/Year Fee Protecting Your Bank, Not You
hook: There's a hidden fee inside most mortgage payments that protects your bank — not you — and it's costing the average homeowner fourteen hundred dollars every single year.
angle: PMI is sold as 'mortgage insurance' but it insures the lender, not the borrower — and lenders are legally required to remove it at 80% LTV but never proactively notify you
audience: First-time homebuyers and existing homeowners who put down less than 20% and have never checked whether PMI can be removed
key_numbers: Average PMI duration before removal: 7+ years
Lenders required to cancel at 78% LTV automatically — but you can request it at 80%
